agent_pruning_opportunities.title: Conditional Pruning or Pass-Through Bypass of contract_independent_review_agent
agent_pruning_opportunities.observed_problem: Agent 'contract_independent_review_agent' (Senior Contract Compliance Reviewer) performs repetitive secondary verification consuming an average of 3.67s per execution run. In non-deviating or low-risk cases, its output merely confirms upstream agent findings without altering the workflow decision path.

supporting_evidence.declared_responsibilities: Deduplicate findings, calibrate severity ratings, and highlight issues needing legal counsel.

agent_pruning_opportunities.proposed_solution: Prune 'contract_independent_review_agent' from the standard baseline execution path, converting it into a dynamic, conditional auditor triggered only when upstream ambiguity or high-risk deviations are detected.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Negligible risk when paired with strict upstream confidence thresholds.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Immediate latency reduction on baseline path.
tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: Direct reduction in prompt and completion tokens.

agent_consolidation_opportunities.title: Consolidate contract_intake_agent and clause_extraction_agent into Unified Agent
agent_consolidation_opportunities.observed_problem: Agents 'contract_intake_agent' and 'clause_extraction_agent' share tightly coupled operational scopes and require high intermediate data handoffs. Executing them as separate LLM agents introduces redundant context re-loading and inter-agent serialization latency (1.81s + 1.96s = 3.77s).
agent_consolidation_opportunities.proposed_solution: Merge 'contract_intake_agent' and 'clause_extraction_agent' into a single specialized agent with unified system instructions, eliminating the intermediate payload serialization and reducing prompt token re-transmission.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Maintains full reasoning fidelity by handling extraction and categorization in a single coherent prompt.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Significant latency reduction by eliminating one agent dispatch round-trip.
tradeoffs_and_risks.output_quality_risk: Low (joint extraction is well within standard LLM contextual capabilities).

workflow_parallelization_opportunities.title: Parallel Execution of compliance_deviation_agent and risk_ambiguity_agent
workflow_parallelization_opportunities.observed_problem: Agents 'compliance_deviation_agent' (1.85s) and 'risk_ambiguity_agent' (3.04s) are currently executed sequentially (total: 4.88s), despite having completely independent processing scopes and no mutual data dependencies.

supporting_evidence.dependency_verification: Verified independent: No direct/transitive edge between compliance_deviation_agent and risk_ambiguity_agent, and no shared I/O coupling.

workflow_parallelization_opportunities.proposed_solution: Execute 'compliance_deviation_agent' and 'risk_ambiguity_agent' concurrently using an asynchronous scatter-gather branch. Join their outputs prior to downstream synthesis.

expected_benefit.critical_path_impact: Cuts 1.85s directly from sequential critical path.
expected_benefit.quality_impact: Zero impact on output quality since dependencies are strictly verified.

tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: No additional token cost (concurrent execution uses separate Groq keys).

tool_optimization_opportunities.title: Deterministic Tool Result Caching for clause_extraction_agent
tool_optimization_opportunities.observed_problem: Agent 'clause_extraction_agent' repeatedly evaluates static compliance policies and reference definitions across runs without persistent local caching of deterministic lookup queries.
tool_optimization_opportunities.proposed_solution: Implement an in-memory TTL memoization cache for static policy lookups and clause reference matches.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Zero risk for immutable policy reference lookups.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Sub-millisecond retrieval for cached policy checks.

communication_optimization_opportunities.title: Streamline Intermediate Handoff Payloads to Field-Specific Deltas
communication_optimization_opportunities.observed_problem: Workflow passes full document and global context payloads across sequential agent boundaries (41 detected handoff edges). Intermediate agents receive unneeded upstream metadata, inflating prompt token consumption across every stage.
communication_optimization_opportunities.proposed_solution: Replace raw full-state serialization with typed, field-specific projection schemas. Each agent receives strictly its declared input requirements and emits only newly computed attributes.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Reduces context dilution and LLM attention distraction.

tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: 20-25% reduction in cumulative workflow token volume.

additional_optimization_opportunities.title: Fast-Path Early Exit for Standard/Compliant Artifacts
additional_optimization_opportunities.observed_problem: The target workflow runs through all 10 stages sequentially regardless of input complexity or deviation status. Standard contracts or clean inputs that pass initial verification without issues still execute all downstream remediation and deep analysis loops, consuming ~57.1s.
additional_optimization_opportunities.proposed_solution: Introduce a fast-path conditional checkpoint: if zero high-risk ambiguities or compliance deviations are identified in early stages, bypass extensive multi-agent reconciliation and jump directly to final report generation.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Maintains strict rigor by restricting fast-path to zero-deviation verified cases.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Over 50% latency reduction on clean input distributions.
tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: Cuts token spend in half for routine standard cases.
